sections.Profile:
"Saratoga" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Manufacturing Company on October 30, 1948. Designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, three passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Parks, Single Player, Wood Rail, City, Original Theme
